id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying a 400 on the reddit ads profiles fan out

review.posthog_relevance: Reddit Ads warehouse ingestion reliability and account compatibility handling
review.reason: Adds a non-retryable error entry for Reddit Ads 400 responses, preventing wasted retries on accounts lacking the community profiles feature, and includes a corresponding test assertion. This demonstrates a bounded correctness and reliability improvement for the Reddit Ads ingestion workflow.
review.uncertainty: The actual production impact and frequency of this specific Reddit API error are not established by the code alone; the benefit is inferred from the implementation rather than observed historical data.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No binary or generated-only hunks. No score assigned yet.

observations.behavior: Adds a new non-retryable error entry for Reddit Ads 400 responses on the profiles fan-out parent fetch, with a comment explaining that Reddit rejects accounts without the profiles feature and retries cannot recover this.
observations.code_quote: "/profiles?page.size=100": "Reddit Ads rejected the request for this account's profiles. This ad account may not have Reddit's community profiles feature enabled.",
observations.posthog_connection: Reddit Ads warehouse ingestion: Reddit returns 400 for accounts lacking the community profiles feature; this hunk prevents the ingestion worker from retrying this request, avoiding wasted retries and potential account lockout. This could help PostHog users avoid repeated failed ingestion attempts and improve warehouse setup reliability.

observations.behavior: Adds a corresponding test assertion for the Reddit Ads 400 error on the profiles fan-out parent fetch, including the specific Reddit API error message.
observations.code_quote: "400 Client Error: Bad Request for url: https://ads-api.reddit.com/api/v3/ad_accounts/d56c38c6-058a-4196-9795-284f820d27a6/profiles?page.size=100 | api error: code=400",
observations.posthog_connection: Adds test coverage for Reddit Ads 400 errors, including the specific Reddit API error message. This could help PostHog maintainers detect and diagnose issues with Reddit Ads account compatibility and prevent false positives in error handling.
